Database not configured. Tap below to pick a .kdbx and match it to a server database.

DeltaSync requires a server. You or your administrator must have set one up (PHP + PostgreSQL), generated an enrollment token via the admin CLI, and given you the server URL. This app does not work standalone — it is a client to an already-running server.\n\nSee https://gitlab.com/Star95/keepass-deltasync for setup instructions.
Enter your .kdbx master password to decrypt locally.
Pulled: %1$d entries, %2$d deletions\nPushed: %3$d entries, %4$d deletions\nServer seq: %5$d
Trades a one-time enrollment token (issued by the server\'s administrator) for a permanent device token. The app generates a local X25519 keypair stored in Android Keystore.
Server URL and enrollment token are required.
Server URL must start with https:// or http://
Pick your local .kdbx file and match it to a database on the server. The app remembers the configuration and runs periodic background sync.
No databases on the server. Create one via the desktop client first.
